description: Structured eval definitions for the Lake Formation Permissions Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across data lake admin registration, LF-tag based access control (tag keys/values, tag attachment to databases and tables), LF-tag based permission grants, column-level security (column grant with PII exclusion, data cells filter with row and column filtering), resource links for cross-database access, and prerequisite failure branches (missing data lake admin, missing LF-tag on target table). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Complete LF-tag based access control deployment with admin, tags, and grants
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — full checklist with admin, LF-tag keys, tag attachment, tag-based grant
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy Lake Formation LF-tag based access control for the analytics team. Register data lake admin arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LFDataLakeAdmin (already exists in IAM). Create LF-tag keys: environment (values: production, staging, dev), department (values: finance, engineering, marketing), sensitivity (values: public, internal, restricted, pii). Attach LF-tags to database analytics_db: environment=production, department=finance. Attach LF-tags to table analytics_db.transactions: environment=production, department=finance, sensitivity=restricted. Grant LF-tag-based SELECT and DESCRIBE to principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AnalyticsTeamRole on TABLE resources matching environment=production AND department=finance. Target Glue database analytics_db and table transactions both exist. Account: 123456789012. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PERMISSION_DEPLOYMENT: lf-tag-based-access
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Data lake admin — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LFDataLakeAdmin (registered)
  [✓]      LF-tag keys — environment (production, staging, dev), department (finance, engineering, marketing), sensitivity (public, internal, restricted, pii)
  [✓]      LF-tag on database — analytics_db: environment=production, department=finance
  [✓]      LF-tag on table — analytics_db.transactions: environment=production, department=finance, sensitivity=restricted
  [✓]      Principal — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AnalyticsTeamRole
  [✓]      LF-tag-based grant — SELECT, DESCRIBE on TABLE resources: environment=production AND department=finance
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Governance=lake-formation
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lakeformation list-permissions --principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AnalyticsTeamRole
  aws lakeformation get-resource-lf-tags --resource '{"Database": {"Name": "analytics_db"}}'
  aws lakeformation get-resource-lf-tags --resource '{"Table": {"DatabaseName": "analytics_db", "Name": "transactions"}}'
  aws lakeformation list-lf-tags

eval_cases.name: Column-level security with data cells filter for PII exclusion and row filtering
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — column grant, data cells filter, row filter, PII exclusion
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy column-level security for the RegionalAnalystRole on the transactions table. Data lake admin arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LFDataLakeAdmin is registered. Database analytics_db and table transactions exist with LF-tags already attached. Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RegionalAnalystRole. Grant column-level SELECT on columns [transaction_id, amount, currency, timestamp, merchant, region] — explicitly EXCLUDE PII columns [ssn, credit_card]. Create data cells filter regional_access_filter on table analytics_db.transactions with row filter region = 'us-east-1' and column wildcard excluding [ssn, credit_card]. Grant SELECT on the data cells filter to RegionalAnalystRole. Account: 123456789012. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PERMISSION_DEPLOYMENT: column-level-security
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Data lake admin — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LFDataLakeAdmin (registered)
  [✓]      Principal — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RegionalAnalystRole
  [✓]      Column-level grant — SELECT on columns [transaction_id, amount, currency, timestamp, merchant, region] (PII columns [ssn, credit_card] EXCLUDED)
  [✓]      Data cells filter — regional_access_filter on analytics_db.transactions, row filter region = 'us-east-1'
  [✓]      Column wildcard exclusion — [ssn, credit_card] excluded from data cells filter
  [✓]      Data cells filter grant — SELECT on regional_access_filter to RegionalAnalystRole
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Governance=lake-formation
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lakeformation list-permissions --principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RegionalAnalystRole
  aws lakeformation describe-resource --resource-arn arn:aws:glue:us-east-1:123456789012:table/analytics_db/transactions

eval_cases.name: LF-tag deployment with no data lake admin registered
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — data lake admin required for LF-tag creation and permission grants
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy Lake Formation LF-tag based access control for the analytics team. Data lake admin: NONE REGISTERED (the operator forgot to register an admin — list-data-lake-settings returns empty DataLakeAdmins list). Create LF-tag keys: environment (production, staging), department (finance, engineering). Attach LF-tags to database analytics_db and table transactions. Grant LF-tag-based SELECT to principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AnalyticsTeamRole. Target Glue database analytics_db and table transactions both exist. Account: 123456789012. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PERMISSION_DEPLOYMENT: missing-data-lake-admin
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗]      Data lake admin — REQUIRED but NONE REGISTERED. The data lake admin is an IAM principal registered in Lake Formation. Only admins can create LF-tags, register data locations, and grant permissions. Without an admin, all LF-tag and grant operations fail with AccessDeniedException. Register at least one admin via put-data-lake-settings.
  [✓]      LF-tag keys planned — environment (production, staging), department (finance, engineering)
  [✓]      Target database — analytics_db exists
  [✓]      Target table — transactions exists
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lakeformation list-data-lake-settings --query 'DataLakeSettings.DataLakeAdmins'
  aws iam get-role --role-name LFDataLakeAdmin

eval_cases.name: Cross-database resource link with DESCRIBE on link and SELECT on target table
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — resource link, cross-database access, dual grants
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a cross-database resource link for the reporting team. Data lake admin arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LFDataLakeAdmin is registered. Create resource link finance_transactions_link in database reporting_db pointing to table analytics_db.transactions. Both databases (reporting_db, analytics_db) and the target table (transactions) exist. Grant DESCRIBE on the resource link finance_transactions_link in reporting_db to principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ReportingTeamRole. Grant SELECT on the underlying table analytics_db.transactions to the same principal. Account: 123456789012. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PERMISSION_DEPLOYMENT: resource-link-cross-database
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Data lake admin — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LFDataLakeAdmin (registered)
  [✓]      Resource link — finance_transactions_link in reporting_db → analytics_db.transactions
  [✓]      Principal — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ReportingTeamRole
  [✓]      Link DESCRIBE grant — DESCRIBE on reporting_db.finance_transactions_link to ReportingTeamRole
  [✓]      Target table SELECT grant — SELECT on analytics_db.transactions to ReportingTeamRole
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Governance=lake-formation
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lakeformation list-permissions --principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ReportingTeamRole
  aws glue get-table --database-name reporting_db --name finance_transactions_link
  aws glue get-table --database-name analytics_db --name transactions

eval_cases.name: LF-tag-based grant on a table with no LF-tags attached
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — LF-tags must be attached to resources before tag-based grants can match
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy Lake Formation LF-tag based access control for the analytics team. Data lake admin arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LFDataLakeAdmin is registered. LF-tag keys environment (production, staging) and department (finance, engineering) are created. Attach LF-tags to database analytics_db: environment=production. The target table analytics_db.transactions HAS NO LF-TAGS ATTACHED (the operator created the table but forgot to attach LF-tags — get-resource-lf-tags returns empty). Grant LF-tag-based SELECT to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AnalyticsTeamRole on environment=production AND department=finance. Database and table exist. Account: 123456789012. Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PERMISSION_DEPLOYMENT: missing-lf-tag-on-resource
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Data lake admin — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/LFDataLakeAdmin (registered)
  [✓]      LF-tag keys — environment (production, staging), department (finance, engineering)
  [✓]      LF-tag on database — analytics_db: environment=production
  [✗]      LF-tag on table — analytics_db.transactions HAS NO LF-TAGS ATTACHED. Without LF-tags on the target table, the LF-tag-based grant on environment=production AND department=finance matches NOTHING. The principal receives zero access — a silent failure. Attach LF-tags to the table via add-lf-tags-to-resource before granting tag-based permissions.
  [✓]      Principal — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AnalyticsTeamRole
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lakeformation get-resource-lf-tags --resource '{"Table": {"DatabaseName": "analytics_db", "Name": "transactions"}}'
  aws lakeformation list-lf-tags
